searchText: i'm not really sure about earlier usually if you miss flight they have"flat tire rule" supposedly let you stand by but i would play up your press credentials, frequent flyer status etc and it might come down to agent you get discretion, whether having good day blah blah blah!any. these are former northwest agents not to discourage you but it's hit or miss on getting good ones some are pretty hard core. hope you are in frequent flyer program if not sign up you should get pretty major miles and if you are premium status they can definitely stand by same day no charge and the even go ahead of me when i stand by ... hope this helps good luck and go tigers luanne
